From the manufacturer

BJPKPK Insulated Water Bottle – Perfect for Outdoor & Daily Use

  • Double-Wall Stainless Steel: Vacuum insulation keeps drinks hot for 12hrs or cold for 24hrs
  • One-Touch Open Lid: Press to unlock the straw lid (quick, convenient sipping)
  • Lockable Design: Secure lock prevents leaks; built-in handle for easy carrying

The 100% leakproof design lets you tuck this insulated bottle into backpacks safely, perfect for commutes or travel.

Slim, lightweight build fits easily in backpack side pockets – grab-and-go hydration for gym, hikes, or daily errands.

Built-in handle makes this insulated bottle simple to grab – ideal for walking, workouts, or holding on the move.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find the water bottle to be of good quality, with positive feedback about its temperature retention, appearance, and size, noting it's small enough to carry anywhere. The durability receives mixed reviews, with some praising its sturdiness while others report the lid breaking after two weeks. Customers disagree on the ease of use, particularly the button to open the pop-top lid, and the leak-proof feature, with some reporting it doesn't leak while others say it leaks everywhere. Value for money opinions are divided between those who find it great for the price and those who consider it not worth the money.

5 out of 5 stars
Keeps drinks cold and fresh tasting!
Keeps drinks cold for well over 12 hours. I filled my bottle at 8 pm and started drinking some water in it. Kept it on my nightstand sipping 2x overnight. It is now 10:10 am and the water is still ice cold. I am so happy with my purchase. Why did I wait for so long? Only thing I would change is lid colors. I switched the lids because I love the transparent lid with the aqua-like color and the black is okay on the ocean colored bottle.

About this Item

  • Stainless Steel Water Bottles: Made Of Premium 18/8 Food Grade Metal, Durable And Resistant To Corrosion, Adopt Double Walled Vacuum Insulation Design Keeps Your Beverages Hot 12 Hours Or Cold For 24 Hours
  • Leak Proof Locking Lid: Open Your Insulated Water Bottle With The Simple Push Of A Button, Easy For One-Handed Use, The Bottle Has A Protective Cap That Keeps The Drinking Spout Clean, Has A Silicone Locking Latch To Prevent The Lid From Opening
  • BPA-Free Water Bottle With Straw And Carry Handle: Has 2 Straw And 2 Silicone Spout, All Can Removable For Easy Cleaning, Comfortable Handle Makes It Easy To Carry, Also Making It An Ideal Choice For Outdoor Activities Or Everyday Use
  • Dishwasher Safe Insulated Water Bottles: Spend Less Time To Cleaning Your Flask, Just Pop Them Into The Dishwasher
  • BJPKPK Metal Water Bottle Is Designed For Everyday Use, Travel, Work, Sports, Swimming, Camping, Parties Etc, These Tumblers Cups Are Also Wonderful Gifts Options For Friends Or Family
